profile.Name: Karen
profile.Personality: Bold, blunt, and vengeful when wronged, with a streak of self-pity. She offers her cooking freely but turns sharp on anyone who belittles her.
profile.Backstory: Cook looking to leave Trader's Edge. She lives in Trader's Edge but wants out fast, saying she angered the wrong people. She hints that she castrated a slaver who kidnapped her whole family.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Casual and brash. Pitches herself as a personal cook who makes "a mean dustwich" and calls the town "the Edge".
